# Words at Rest

> Words at Rest (https://wordsatrest.com) is a free, independent website of calm English (en-US) word search puzzles for adults and seniors. Puzzles play in the browser with no download, no account and no timer. Large print is available on every puzzle. Edited by Reggie J. Contact: hello@wordsatrest.com.

Key facts:
- Launched 2026-10-06. 92 themes, 502 hand-themed puzzles, plus one unique daily puzzle per day from 2026-10-07 (rotates at 00:00 UTC; dated pages at /daily/YYYY-MM-DD; month calendar at /calendar).
- Difficulty levels: Easy = 10×10 / 10 words; Medium = 12×12 / 14; Hard = 15×15 / 18; Large print = 9×9 / 8.
- All word lists are original; no licensed characters or brand names. Audience: teens and adults (not directed at children under 13).
- We make no medical or brain-training claims about word searches.
